# Educationise

> > Educationise is an AI-powered educational platform providing learning tools, resources, and practical utilities for students and educators.

Educationise combines educational content with practical productivity tools, leveraging AI to enhance learning experiences. The platform offers both teaching resources and utility tools like date calculators to support academic and professional planning.

## Key Topics

- AI Tools
- Educational Platform
- EdTech Resources
- AI Learning
- Teaching Methods
- Classroom Management
- Date Calculator
- Scheduling Tools
- Deadline Planning
- Free Educational Tools
- Blog Resources
- Business Dates
- Date Arithmetic

## Core Platform

- [Educationise Homepage](https://educationise.com): Main hub for AI tools and educational resources for learning

## Productivity Tools

- [30 Days From Today – Find the Exact Date & Day Instantly](https://educationise.com/30-days-from-today): Free date calculator tool to find dates 30 days in advance for planning and deadline management
